description: Get one media library item by id, with a fresh signed_url that expires after one hour. Ids must be copied exactly from aidelly_list_media or an upload result. To attach it, pass the id as content.media[].media_id (or the bare UUID) when creating a post; the whole item is not a valid media entry.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_get_media
title: Get Media
